description: Mints one or more Ashfields NFTs. Automatically approves $ASH if the current allowance is insufficient, then submits the mint transaction and waits for confirmation. Returns the minted token IDs and OpenSea links. Burns 100,000 $ASH per token permanently (sent to 0xdead).

quantity.description: Number of tokens to mint. Must be between 1 and 5 per transaction.

name: mint_ashfield
